overall_goal: Cool, peel, and slice the boiled egg

goals.rationale: The hot water is drained and replaced with cold tap water to cool the egg down for peeling.
The egg is shaken, cracked on the counter, and carefully peeled to remove all shell fragments.

goals.description: Prepare the chopping board and slice the egg
goals.rationale: A chopping board is set up on the counter, the peeled egg is placed on it, and then cut into four slices.
